event.description: Union closest block-0 pre-FF norm scales 8 and 1
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,481 parameters at 99.110000%, a +0.110000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 81 prior macro-attempts in this family and 669 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0183/micro-0005 at 1481 parameters and 99.110000%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0182/micro-0001 (discard, 98.990000%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of block 0's pre-feed-forward normalization scales: union coordinates 8 and 1, values 0.4341307580 and 0.4471161664 (difference 1.299e-02), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: upstream nonlinear normalization has local scale redundancy distinct from final normalization, preserving qualification at 1,480 parameters. It is more informative than the next scale union (difference 1.343e-02) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated scale test; biases remain independent. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
